$comment: Grafana panel JSON for the platform-api outbox drainer health view. Drop into an existing dashboard's panels array; the panel ids are placeholders — set them when integrating. PromQL queries below assume the platform-api `/internal/metrics` scrape target is named `platform-api`.
title: Outbox Drainer Health (platform-api)

panels.title: Outbox publish throughput (5m rate)
panels.description: Rows successfully published per second, broken down by event type. Sustained zero with non-zero queue depth (see oldest_pending) → drainer or upstream MQ problem.

panels.title: Outbox publish failure rate (5m)
panels.description: Publish attempts that threw, per second. Sustained > 0 → upstream MQ or catalog routing problem; rows will be marked FAILED after maxRetries.

panels.title: Oldest pending outbox row (seconds)
panels.description: Approximate age of the oldest UNPROCESSED row observed in the most recent drainer scan. 0 → backlog drained. Sustained > 60s → drainer can't keep up. Approximate: bounded by batchSize when backlog > batchSize.

panels.title: Outbox lease acquisitions per minute
panels.description: Drainer poll cycles that won the lease. Should be roughly constant (one winner per poll across replicas). Sustained 0 → no replica is acquiring the lease (likely DDB lease-store issue).

alerts.name: OutboxBackingUp
alerts.summary: Oldest UNPROCESSED outbox row > 120s — drainer may be falling behind.

alerts.name: OutboxLeaseStarvation
alerts.summary: No replica has won the outbox drainer lease in 5 minutes.
